sentences.text: Shri Amit Khatri - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri C.K. Mishra - Government Advocate for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 507/20222 dated 16.10.2022 registered at Police Station Bilkhiriya, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 465, 467, 468, 420, 419 of the IPC.
2. The counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
Counsel contends that there are allegation against the co-accused Ramdas Sahu who alienated the property to one Mandavi Sahu and the present applicant stood as a witness in one of the sale-deed.
Apart from the said allegation, there are no other allegation against the present applicant.
The trial court while dismissing the application has ventured upon to observe that it was possible that the present applicant was known to Mandavi Sahu.
It is contended by the counsel that the present applicant has not derived any benefit nor any consideration has been passed NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12133 2 MCRC-10416-2025 to her.

The co-accused Anuj Sahu, was enlarged on bail by this Court on 31/05/2024 in M.Cr.C.
No.19683/2024, hence, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
3. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that looking to the nature of allegation, the applicant is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

5. Looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that apart from the fact that the applicant was witness in one of the deeds executed between the co-accused and the complainant, there are no allegation against the present applicant, thus, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting Officer/trial Court concerned for her appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court during course of trial, as the case may be, during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
